name: 11-victorian-diagram

No gradients, no blurred antialiasing, no background paper, no cast shadows, no labels, no text, no grid, no board. Full transparent 3:1 canvas, 6-column2-row square-cell grid, empty gutters, uncropped complete pieces. Reference hatching belongs on the board later, NOT inside transparent sprite backgrounds.
